_doc: Maps the Figma export to routes and declares what is in scope for tokens. Replaces the hardcoded slug regexes that used to live in extract.mjs. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_tokenScope: Canvases whose styles define the shipped design system. Everything else (Cover, separators, 'Design Systems' library page, superseded drafts) is ignored so dead styles never reach json/system-design.json.
_pages: Figma page artboard name -> route slug. Artboards are the 1920-wide FRAMEs nested inside the canvas SECTIONs. Anything not listed here produces no page JSON.
_componentLibrarySections: Sections that stage reusable component sets rather than page layouts. Skipped by page slicing; still in scope for tokens.
_legacy: Superseded page artboards. Kept out of both page slicing and token scope. See docs/page-migration-status.md — these use a retired Montserrat / #104891 design system.
